title: ChatGPT is about to become the first AI chatbot in the EU’s toughest tier

content_html:
ChatGPT is about to become the first AI chatbot to face Europe’s toughest platform rules. The European Commission plans to place OpenAI’s chatbot and the gaming platform Roblox under the strictest tier of the Digital Services Act. The designation could come as soon as August.

The move was first reported by Bloomberg, citing a person familiar with the plan. ChatGPT’s search function would be designated a “very large online search engine.” Roblox would become a “very large online platform.” Both crossed the DSA’s trigger of 45 million monthly users in the bloc.

The Commission was more guarded in public. Its spokesperson, Thomas Regnier, told Reuters a designation was “definitely possible” and could “come sooner or later.” OpenAI said it continues to engage positively with Brussels. Roblox did not comment.

What the label actually demands

The tag is not a trophy. It adds ChatGPT and Roblox to a list of around two dozen platforms carrying the DSA’s heaviest obligations. That group already runs from Meta and X to Amazon and TikTok. They get four months from designation to comply.

That means annual risk assessments and independent audits, transparency reports, ad-transparency rules, and a recommendation feed not based on profiling. They must share data with regulators and vetted researchers, and report criminal offences. There is also a supervisory fee. Breaching the rules risks fines of up to 6 per cent of global annual turnover.

The point is systemic risk. Designated services must identify and mitigate harms tied to illegal content, elections, discrimination, gender-based violence, and users’ mental and physical health. For a chatbot and a children’s game, those are not abstract categories.

Why these two

Roblox is an obvious target. It faces lawsuits and criticism over child-safety failures, and has been rolling out age checks and age-separated chat in response. The DSA’s core aim is protecting children online, and Roblox is where millions of them gather.

ChatGPT is the more novel case. OpenAI is fighting wrongful-death suits from families who say the chatbot failed users in crisis, and Florida has sued the company and Sam Altman. Pulling a generative-AI product into the top tier signals that Brussels sees chatbots as platforms to be policed, not tools to wave through.

A familiar fight

This is now a well-worn pattern. The Commission has opened more than a dozen probes since the DSA took effect. It fined AliExpress €550m, penalised Temu, and hit X with a €120m charge it is appealing. It has escalated an addictive-design probe into Meta and charged TikTok over child safety.

It is also part of a wider European push, from France’s under-15 social-media ban to a growing AI rulebook. The Trump administration calls the DSA a form of “economic extortion” against American firms. Critics ask, more pointedly, why Europe regulates the platforms it cannot seem to build.

The counter is straightforward. As X shows, a designation is a demand, not a cure, and the platform is no one’s model of online safety despite its fine. But forcing two of the internet’s most scrutinised services to open their systems to auditors still beats taking their word that all is well.

content_html_zh:
ChatGPT 即将成为第一个面临欧洲最严格平台规则的人工智能聊天机器人。 欧盟委员会计划将 OpenAI 的聊天机器人和游戏平台 Roblox 置于《数字服务法》最严格的监管之下。 该指定最早可能在八月份做出。

彭博社首先援引一位知情人士的话报道了这一举措。 ChatGPT 的搜索功能将被指定为“非常大的在线搜索引擎”。 Roblox 将成为一个“非常大的在线平台”。 两者都超过了 DSA 规定的欧盟每月 4500 万用户的触发值。

委员会在公开场合更加谨慎。 其发言人托马斯·雷尼耶 (Thomas Regnier) 告诉路透社，被指定“绝对有可能”，并且“迟早会出现”。 OpenAI 表示将继续与布鲁塞尔积极接触。 Roblox 没有发表评论。

标签的实际要求是什么

标签不是奖杯。 它将 ChatGPT 和 Roblox 添加到了承担 DSA 最重义务的大约两打平台的列表中。 该组织已经从 Meta 和 X 扩展到亚马逊和 TikTok。 从指定到遵守规定，他们有四个月的时间。

这意味着年度风险评估和独立审计、透明度报告、广告透明度规则以及不基于分析的推荐源。 他们必须与监管机构和经过审查的研究人员共享数据，并报告刑事犯罪。 还有监督费。 违反规定将面临高达全球年营业额 6% 的罚款。

重点是系统性风险。 指定服务必须识别并减轻与非法内容、选举、歧视、性别暴力以及用户身心健康相关的危害。 对于聊天机器人和儿童游戏来说，这些都不是抽象的类别。

为什么这两个

Roblox 是一个明显的目标。 它因儿童安全失败而面临诉讼和批评，并一直在推出年龄检查和按年龄区分的聊天作为回应。 DSA 的核心目标是保护上网儿童，而 Roblox 是数百万人聚集的地方。

ChatGPT 是一个更新颖的案例。 OpenAI 正在与家庭提起的非正常死亡诉讼作斗争，这些家庭称聊天机器人在危机中辜负了用户，佛罗里达州已起诉该公司和萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman)。 将生成式人工智能产品纳入顶层表明布鲁塞尔将聊天机器人视为需要监管的平台，而不是可以通过的工具。

熟悉的战斗

现在，这是一种陈旧的模式。 自 DSA 生效以来，委员会已启动十多项调查。 它对 AliExpress 处以 5.5 亿欧元的罚款，对 Temu 进行了处罚，并对 X 处以 1.2 亿欧元的罚款，这很有吸引力。 它升级了对 Meta 的成瘾设计调查，并就儿童安全问题对 TikTok 提出指控。

这也是欧洲更广泛推动措施的一部分，从法国 15 岁以下社交媒体禁令到不断完善的人工智能规则手册。 特朗普政府称 DSA 是针对美国公司的“经济勒索”形式。 批评者更尖锐地问，为什么欧洲要监管它似乎无法建立的平台。

计数器很简单。 正如 X 所表明的那样，指定是一种需求，而不是一种治疗方法，尽管该平台很好，但它并不是任何人的在线安全模型。 但强迫互联网上最受审查的两家服务机构向审计人员开放其系统仍然比相信他们所说的一切都好要好。
